skill.summary: End-to-end coach for authors producing an audiobook — deciding self-narration vs hiring a narrator, choosing distribution path (ACX exclusive / non-exclusive...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: End-to-end audiobook production coaching for authors.

- Guides decisions on self-narration vs. hiring a narrator, royalty math, and narrator casting/auditions.
- Covers distribution options: ACX exclusive/non-exclusive, Findaway Voices, direct, and more.
- Explains audiobook production workflow, including script prep, home vs. studio recording, editing, and mastering.
- Diagnoses common pitfalls that delay or derail audiobook launches, such as ACX QC rejections and royalty lock-in.
- Provides triggers for engagement based on common author questions and scenarios.
